claims: Italy defeated Puerto Rico 8-6 on March 14, 2026.
The game was at Daikin Park in Houston.
The date of the game was Saturday, March 14, 2026.
Italy advanced to the semifinals of the World Baseball Classic for the first time in tournament history.
Vinnie Pasquantino had an RBI single for Italy.
Jac Caglianone had an RBI single for Italy.
Dylan DeLucia provided 4 scoreless innings in relief for Italy.
Puerto Rico trailed 8-2 before mounting a comeback.
Puerto Rico scored 4 runs in the 8th inning.
Christian Vázquez had a 2-run single for Puerto Rico.
Puerto Rico took a 1-0 lead on a Willi Castro solo home run in the first inning.
Italy scored four runs in the bottom of the first inning against Puerto Rico starter Seth Lugo.
Italy extended their lead to 8-2 in the fourth inning.
Andrew Fischer had a 2-run double for Italy.
J.J. D'Orazio had a 2-run double for Italy.
Puerto Rico brought the score to 8-6 in the eighth inning.
Greg Weissert closed the game for Italy.
Italy will face the winner of the Japan-Venezuela matchup in the semifinals in Miami.
